summary: Verified all 3 new features end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL: (1) Quick Edit pricing-unit toggle in Tiles Manager, (2) Clearance Hub single-pill status click flow, (3) Homepage Recently Viewed strip. All positive/negative cases pass and original state was restored.
critical_code_review_comments: Clearance Hub pill hover text — DOM contains BOTH labels ('Draft' + 'Publish' / 'Live' + 'Unpublish') at all times, with CSS visibility swapping on hover. Not a bug (works visually), but automated .textContent returns concatenated 'DraftPublish' / 'LiveUnpublish'. If tests need to assert hover text alone, prefer role/aria-label or sr-only classes.
AdminDashboard: React warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' logged when loading /admin/clearance. Pre-existing, unrelated to this feature but worth fixing.
Several 403 responses observed in console on Clearance Hub (some analytics/telemetry endpoint likely). Pre-existing, not related.

success_rate.backend: 100% (main-agent smoke tests trusted; UI-driven quick-update save round-trip verified via toast + reopen persistence)

seed_data_creation: None. Toggled Tiles Manager row SKU 5445 pricing_unit unit→m2→unit (restored). Clearance SKU 5225 draft→live→draft (restored). Homepage/collection localStorage seeded then left in place (harmless client-only key).
